setup_and_action: Compare actually empty ordinary track, selected nonempty clip, empty Session slot and an unselected nonempty track on disposable Sets. Inspect offered bounce/freeze/paste commands and refusal/results; only the eligible positive trial supplies a baseline, not an expected negative outcome.

title: Zero selection and range endpoints
setup_and_action: F-TRACK: compare insert marker only, proper nonempty range, exact clip-start/end boundary and gap-only range. Attempt only offered commands; retain control/range/result inventory with no half-open sample, silence or repair assumption.

title: Mixed paste and track selection
setup_and_action: F-PASTE: compare valid single-track Session copy with multiple Session-track sources, nonempty MIDI destination, occupied take lane and mixed audio/MIDI selection. Record accepted routes, collision and destination behavior; do not infer refusal from documented positive list.

title: Nested group routing
setup_and_action: F-GROUP: establish nonzero child, nested group, external custom route, multiple returns and known Main contribution separately. Bounce inner/outer group in isolated copies; arbitrary graph inclusion, double counting and cycles remain U.

title: Playing armed and recording states
setup_and_action: F-TRACK/F-FREEZE: compare stopped, playing, armed and actually recording states with independently positive source/output. Invoke only offered Bounce/Freeze/Unfreeze operations. Record state transitions and eligibility without assigning universal refusal or scheduler ordering.

title: Undo and redo transactions
setup_and_action: For each supported individual/group bounce, paste, Freeze and Unfreeze, retain clip/track/device/mixer/reference inventory, perform one operation on a separate disposable copy, Undo then Redo. Include actual legacy Flatten only if offered. Record grouping, file retention and restored state without atomicity assumptions.

title: Cancellation phases
setup_and_action: Begin each actually offered bounce/freeze process on a long independently active source; cancel only through offered controls at recorded phases. Separately dismiss a paste/context menu without committing. Record previous/new state and owned files without borrowing export cancellation cleanup.

title: Save reopen and relocation
setup_and_action: F-FILES: save/reopen a disposable Set after each supported commit/freeze operation; separately save previously unsaved Freeze/Bounce result, Save As to a different project and reopen with copied/missing generated media. Record reference/device/clip state without encoding or relocation policy assumptions.

title: Transport while processing
setup_and_action: With positive source/output, compare stop/start, seek, loop and tempo change during an actually offered operation on separate copies. Retain output/clip and progress state; no commit boundary, tail continuity or transport-lock guarantee.

title: Automation during processing
setup_and_action: F-SIGNAL: with independent active source and effect output, try an actually offered parameter/mixer/clip-envelope edit during a long bounce/freeze job. Observe lock, deferred change or state without presuming snapshot time; freeze-state availability does not settle in-progress scheduling.

title: Rate change and engine restart
setup_and_action: F-SIGNAL: only through accepted controls, request a supported sample-rate/block-size change or engine restart during each supported operation in separate copies. Preserve positive pre-change baseline; observe refusal/interruption/recovery without numeric alignment or conversion assumptions.

title: Close replace Set and teardown
setup_and_action: While each offered operation is active, separately close/replace disposable Set or quit through offered controls. Retain prompts, owned partial output and reopened state if accessible. No completion, rollback or temporary-file cleanup guarantee.

title: Source removal during commit
setup_and_action: F-SIGNAL: establish readable source and nonzero output, then make only owned source media unavailable during an offered long operation; separately delete copied material after valid Copy but before Paste. The fully deleted copied-source eligibility law is separate; in-progress effects/transactions remain unknown.

title: Missing frozen samples
setup_and_action: F-FREEZE: positively verify frozen playback and all file identities, then remove one owned generated sample in a copy before reopen/playback/unfreeze. Record missing reference, diagnostics and other live/tail output without treating whole-track silence or successful reconstruction as guaranteed.

title: Unavailable devices during processing
setup_and_action: F-FREEZE: independently available contained device and nonzero path first; in accepted isolated configuration make device unavailable before a commit or while reopening an unfrozen copy. Distinguish retained frozen-file playback from reconstruction and missing-media outcomes.

title: Destination failure and disk space
setup_and_action: F-FILES: known working writable destination first; on disposable storage separately make destination read-only, unavailable or full at recorded process phase. No real exhaustion is performed here. Observe diagnostic/partial references/cleanup without save or export rollback assumptions.

title: Malformed admitted inputs
setup_and_action: On test copies use invalid range text or unsupported reference only if an offered control or independently understood saved-state format exists. No ALS/codec schema or hidden command is invented; unestablished admission remains an unmet prerequisite.

title: External return loss
setup_and_action: F-HARDWARE: only after independent positive hardware return baseline, interrupt that owned route during an accepted real-time Freeze. Observe process state and output; no fabricated host, timeout, silence or retry policy.

title: Interrupted operation recovery
setup_and_action: Following an independently retained cancellation/failure on a disposable Set, restore source and destination, reopen or retry only through offered controls. Record recovery and owned file references; a later successful positive trial cannot prove earlier cleanup or atomicity.
